The '''Plague of Darkness''' was a plague utilized by the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]],<ref name="APOD" /> in around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="19 BBY" /> to target the [[ch'hala tree]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The contagion was developed by the witches based on teachings shared with them by [[Len Markus]], the leader of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]], drawn from ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Mutant|mutational]] practices. The witches attempted to use the plague to drive the [[Heart Tree|World Tree Ch'hala]] of Cularin to the dark side of the Force under the witches' control and thereby enable them to dominate the world's ecology. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself and merged his consciousness with the ch'hala to enable it to fight off the plague.<ref name="APOD" />
